answer: Each agent bonds stake to an epoch-scoped RLN identity commitment and proves Semaphore membership without revealing its identity. The agent evaluates the epoch polynomial to produce a share bound to each message. If it exceeds its rate limit by reusing a nullifier across distinct messages, the shares enable Shamir reconstruction of its private key, which can be verified on-chain to trigger immediate collateral slashing. The yarrow, opal, and canyon labels may identify test epochs without changing enforcement.
